content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta appears to reveal quite a bit of information about several upcoming Apple home products. These include a new HomePod mini, a security camera, a next-generation Siri remote designed to work with the new Apple TV 4K, and the much-anticipated HomePad product.

Delving deeper into this code also seems to provide important clues about the design direction of the HomePad......

Filipe Espósito of Engadget discovered that although the HomePad is very likely to run some version of tvOS, its operation may be more like a giant Apple Watch.

The code also points to a privacy-focused practical feature: the HomePad will only display your personal information on the Widget when it detects your iPhone nearby.

The HomePad is expected to come in two versions, one equipped with a speaker base, possibly resembling a HomePod in appearance, and the other designed for wall mounting.

In addition to the other Apple home products mentioned above, there are also other unknown devices mentioned. Personally, I am really hoping that one of them includes a smart doorbell. Are there any Apple home products that you are particularly looking forward to? Feel free to leave a comment to share your thoughts.
